title: We'll Ask Grandma
description: After Kid-2 and Kid-3 collect a garter snake, frogs, and toads from the backyard, they ask Pa if they can keep them. When Pa says they already have enough pets, Kid-3 decides they will ask Grandma instead.
alt: In a huge sunny backyard field, Kid-2 proudly holds a small garter snake while Kid-3 holds two frogs. A container of toads, a net, and Kid-3's stuffed gray bunny sit in the grass nearby. Kid-2 asks, 'Can we keep them?' Pa calmly replies, 'No. You already have enough pets.' Kid-3 cheerfully answers, 'Okay. We'll ask Grandma.'
